अशीति (I) num. (It is used in the singular even with a noun in the plural and is always feminine whatever be the gender of the noun.) Eighty.
अशीति (II) f. The number ‘eighty.’
अशीर्षक a. (f. की) Headless.
अशीर्षक a. (f. की) Headless.
असि (I) ind. The second pers. sing. of the present tense of अस् used as an indeclinable in the sense of ‘त्वम् (thou).’ Cf. अस्मि.
असि (II) m. 1. A sword, R.xii.40; 2. a knife used for killing animals.
आशी f. 1. Wishing or bestowing a blessing; 2. a serpent’s fang, e.g. विषमाशीभिरनारतं वमन्तः; 3. a kind of venom.
असि-गण्ड m. a small pillow for the cheek.
असि-जीविन् m. a soldier who fights for wages.
असि-दंष्ट्र, -दंत m. a crocodile.
असि-दंष्ट्र, -दंत m. a crocodile.
असि-धारा f. the edge of a sword, R.x.41, 86.

आसिधार n. A particular vow variously explained; according to some, it consists in standing on the edge of a sword; according to others, in being constantly near a youthful girl and resisting the temptation of sexual enjoyment; (the Yādava explains it thus- युवा युवत्या सार्धं यन्मुग्धभर्तृवदाचरेत् । अन्तर्निवृत्तसंगः स्यादासिधारं व्रतं हि तत्), अभ्यस्यतीव व्रतमासिधारम् R.xiii.67.Figuratively the word is used in the sense of “a difficult task or undertaking.” Thus Bhartr. says- सतां केनोद्दिष्टं विषममसिधाराव्रतमिदम्. (Cf. असिधाराव्रत.)

असि-धारा˚व्रत n. 1. The vow of standing on the edge of a sword (according to some); the vow of keeping constant company with a young lady and yet abstaining from sexual intercourse with her (according to others), See आसिधार; 2. any difficult task, सतां केनोद्दिष्टं विषममसिधाराव्रतमिदम् Bhartr.ii.28, 64.
असि-धाव, -धावक m. an armourer.
असि-धाव, -धावक m. an armourer.
असि-धेनु, -धेनुका f. a knife, Vikr.Ch.iv.69.
असि-धेनु, -धेनुका f. a knife, Vikr.Ch.iv.69.
असि-पत्र (I) m.n. 1. the blade of a sword; 2. a sheath.
असि-पत्र (II) m. the sugarcane, R.xiv.48.
असि-पत्रक m. sugar-cane.
असि-पत्रक˚वन n. a particular hell.
असि-पुत्रिका, -पुत्री f. a knife.
असि-पुत्रिका, -पुत्री f. a knife.
असि-हत्य n. fighting with swords.
असि-हेति f. a soldier armed with a sword.
असिक f. The part of the face between the under-lip and the chin.
आसिक m. A swordsman.
असिक्नी f. A youthful maid-servant of the harem.
असित-अर्चिस् m. fire.
असित-अश्मन्, -उपल m. the lapis lazuli.
असित-अश्मन्, -उपल m. the lapis lazuli.
असित-उत्पल n. the blue lotus.
असित-केशा f. a woman with black hair.
असित-गिरि m. a particular mountain.
असित-नयना f. a blackeyed lady, मा कौलीनादसितनयने (v.l. चकितनयने) मय्याविश्वासिनी भूः Megh.ii.49.
असित-भ्रू a. having black eyelids.
असिद्ध (I) a. (f. द्धा) 1. Raw, unbaked; 2. unaccomplished; 3. not derivable by inference.

असिद्ध (II) m. one of the five fallacious hetus (in logic). It is of three kinds, viz., आश्रयसिद्ध, स्वरूपसिद्ध and व्याप्यतासिद्ध. The first consists in the पक्षत्व property not existing in the पक्ष, the second in the so-called ‘hetu’ not residing in the पक्ष and the third in the साध्यत्व property not residing in the साध्य.
असिद्ध (I) a. (f. द्धा) 1. Raw, unbaked; 2. unaccomplished; 3. not derivable by inference.
आशितंगवीन a. formerly grazed by cattle.
आशितंभव n. 1. food; 2. satisfaction, satiety, e.g. फलैर्यष्वाशितंभवम्.

आशिस् f. 1. Prayer, wish; 2. blessing, benediction (it is thus defined- वात्सल्याद्यत्र मान्येन कनिष्ठस्याभिधीयते । इष्टावधारकं वाक्यमाशीः सा परिकीर्तिता ॥ आशिस् differs from वर in as much as it is a mere expression of good wishes which possibly may not come off true, while वर is a boon sure of fulfilment. Thus we have in Sak. वरः खल्वेष नाशीः iv.) अर्घ्यानुपदमाशिषः R.i.44, K.S.v.76; 3. a serpent’s fang.
आशीर्वाद m. expression of a prayer or wish.
आशीर्वचन n. a blessing, a benediction, आशीर्वचनसंयुक्तां नित्यं यस्मात् प्रकुर्वते S.D.vi.
आशीर्विष m. a snake.
आशी-विष m. 1. a snake in general, गरुत्मदाशीविषभीमदर्शने R.iii.57; 2. a particular species of snakes, कर्णाशीविषभोगिनि प्रशमिते Ve.vi.
